title: Cèmuhî language
description: Austronesian language spoken in New Caledonia
extract: Cèmuhî is an Oceanic language spoken on the island of New Caledonia, in the area of Poindimié, Koné, and Touho. The language has approximately 3,300 speakers and is considered a regional language of France.
